_comment: Move / ability / item usage per species (and per Mega form, keyed e.g. 'Salamence-Mega') for Pokémon Champions Regulation M-C, scraped from Pikalytics' gen9championsvgc2026regmc pokedex on 19 Sep 2026. Usage is a 0–1 fraction. Ladder data only reveals moves that were actually used, so percentages are low and relative — use them for ordering, not as absolute rates. Regenerate periodically; see README 'Refreshing usage stats'.
